prerequisites: Current microprobe must complete and expose actual supported layout/shape, strict integer/epilogue correctness, repeat stability, <=2% random projection screening and full-path hot/cold gains. A GEMM-only gain is insufficient.
Any future shared-buffer or chunk-conversion wrapper needs its own numerical/race/layout microcheck before model execution. Original probe math/source remain frozen.
Actual fullmodel VRAM with original KV64x64, max_prefill3072, session4096 and batch1 must fit; no other processes or KV capacity are reduced.

Excluded actual-input diagnostic smokes, repeated fixed4cell latency/output observations and original-policy20 navigation quality are separate requirements. This investigation must not delay current quality20.

identity.name: expanded_int8_prefill_original_w4_decode
identity.meaning: Same original packed checkpoint but NEW per-channel INT8 weight and per-token INT8 activation arithmetic in selected prefill. Not same-W4 equivalence, not QQQ/QServe reproduction.
identity.original_checkpoint: read-only; original packed W4 tensors retained for decode/fallback

feasible_hook.entry: A new opt-in service/module-map and model subclass only; do not edit frozen primary/wide modules.
feasible_hook.backend: lmdeploy.pytorch.backends.cuda.awq_modules.wq_gemm_forward is looked up by AwqLinearW4A16Impl.forward on every Python forward; same exact wrapper interface can dispatch by registered qweight pointer.
feasible_hook.module_inventory: Exactly144 canonical fused qkv/o/gate_up/down modules across36 layers; validate pointer uniqueness, original loaded-weight inventory, actual K/N/stride/dtype, selected expanded q8/scales identity.
feasible_hook.return_protocol: Flatten original leading dimensions to[M,K], retain FP16 input, add original bias once, restore x.shape[:-1]+(out_features,), and unsqueeze0 if the resulting native protocol is2D. Leave all_reduce handling in native Impl.forward.
feasible_hook.routing: Use StepContext.is_decoding plus registered M bounds, not M alone. All decode/capture calls go to saved original frozen W4 function. Initial fixed trial uses only predeclared supported prefill M; unknown/<=16 M retains explicitly counted native fallback. No silent fallback for mandatory measured M701/2815.
feasible_hook.candidate_scope: Batch1,tp1,dp1,no microbatch,no concurrent requests,no prefix reuse or chunked prefill. Wider/dynamic scope requires new boundary/activation evidence and per-request routing counts.

startup.observed_order: Executor.init builds/loads model, updates configs, builds GraphRunner, allocates KV cache, then warms model. ModelAgent.warmup performs synthetic prefill at max_batch_size=1 before decode graph capture.
startup.preferred_minimal_position: After the existing first synthetic native forward has verified all W4 modules and installed the original frozen fallback; before decode capture. This is the existing wide adapter's safe position, but KV already exists and must be counted.
startup.why_not_constructor: Weights are not loaded in constructor. A load_weights override may see checkpoint shards and precedes model.to(device)/module.update_weights, so mere AWQ inventory completion is not a universal final-device/final-layout barrier.
startup.conversion: Expand one projection at a time, store only winning INT8 physical layout + FP32 channel scale, preserve W4. Hash actual expanded logical weights/scales and original packed tensors, log setup time and allocated/reserved/device-free peaks. Discard all temporary dense/reconstructed tensors immediately.
startup.peak_risk: Probe dense_dequant uses full-KN int32/FP32 intermediates; prepare_weight uses FP32 abs/max intermediates. Per-projection conversion can peak several full tensors beyond the final3.388GiB storage. Sequential layers alone do not bound this to one FP16 temporary.
startup.optional_memory_hardening: Only if actual startup peak requires it: N-column chunks across full K can bound temporaries while preserving per-channel max semantics. Reuse explicit RN div/quantization, materialize contiguous dense chunk, then copy to permanent selected layout. Must independently prove full logical expanded bytes/scales identical to the frozen whole-projection converter; do not silently introduce a different converter.
startup.fullmodel_controls: Keep num_gpu_blocks64 and block_size64. Earlier conversion before cache could expose correct free memory but requires a new guarded lifecycle hook; it does not authorize reducing fixed KV.

graph_and_warmup.native_prefill: CudaGraphMixin.support_cuda_graph returns attn_metadata.is_decoding. CUDAGraphRunner routes prefill directly to model eager. Microprobe graph replay excludes host dispatch gaps that the actual prefill may expose.
graph_and_warmup.explicit_warmup_required: Synthetic M1 never exercises _int_mm because M must be>16. Before service readiness, warm actual expanded weights/layouts and all4 projection shape families with fixed representative M17/701/2815 and maximum3072 for future broad scope, using the actual compute stream and scratch views.
graph_and_warmup.triton_compile: Frozen _quantize_rows and _scale_output already use runtime M/do_not_specialize; K/BK and N remain constexpr. Warm actual pointer alignment/dtype/stride categories and install a fail-closed cold-JIT guard/cache inventory in any new adapter. No online autotune.
graph_and_warmup.limits: Runtime M prevents intended per-length Triton specialization; it does not independently prove every backend/library length has no first-use overhead. torch._int_mm dispatch/cuBLAS lazy state must be warmed and first real-shape observations kept excluded. Only tested shapes are initially eligible.
graph_and_warmup.decode_evidence: Require144 original-native projection capture identities and zero INT8 capture calls; count decode replays with the existing outside-graph observer, not Python dispatch counters. Original native graph/source and event safety remain unchanged.
graph_and_warmup.future_api: Current micro Pipeline allocates buffers/output per object. A future new shared invocation layer must reuse the frozen arithmetic/JIT functions with caller-owned scratch and fresh FP16 output; it needs renewed execution validation, not144 persistent Pipeline instances.

shared_scratch.scope: One owner for the single model compute stream/request path; reject different stream/reentrant concurrent dispatch. ModelAgent uses self.stream for model_forward, separate out/cache streams do not directly own this scratch.
shared_scratch.ordering: Quantization→INT32 GEMM→epilogue enqueued on the same stream. The next projection may reuse Qx/INT32 only after the previous epilogue has consumed them by stream order. No CPU synchronize is needed merely for same-stream ordering; do not insert hidden synchronization into formal timing.
shared_scratch.buffers: Allocate flat Qx INT8, flat INT32 accumulation and FP32 row_scale at maximum capacity. Use flat prefix slices.view(actualM,K or N) for tight contiguous operands; [:M,:N] from a max-width2D buffer has a larger stride and may violate _int_mm contiguous out requirements.
shared_scratch.fp16_output: Allocate a distinct FP16[M,N] result for each projection invocation, preserving ordinary tensor lifetime through attention/MLP/residual consumers. Never return shared output storage that the next projection overwrites. Output can remain in flight after Python returns.
shared_scratch.forbidden: No144 per-module M2815 workspaces; gate_up INT32 alone36×~209MiB would exceed7GiB. No multi-stream pooling without explicit ownership/events and new tests.

actual_activation_diagnostics.when: Only predeclared excluded input_warmup indices0/1 with native2-image/9-image input SHA binding; disable all comparison/copy/reduction hooks for formal timing and policy requests.
actual_activation_diagnostics.preferred_coverage: All144 actual projection calls at each of the two smokes (288 local comparisons) for inexpensive frozen-W4 versus candidate output error. Additional CPU INT64/quantizer selected-row/column checks at layers0/18/35 x4 projections, using actual runtime inputs and scratch before reuse.
actual_activation_diagnostics.operation: At each actual candidate projection, execute candidate once, save its own FP16 output, invoke the saved pure frozen-W4 linear reference on the same X without recursing through dispatch, then compute metrics. Extra reference linears have no attention/KV writes; never call the whole model twice inline on one KV context.
actual_activation_diagnostics.metrics: Per-module actual M/K/N/input dtype/stride, original and expanded tensor SHA, actual selected activation bytes/row indices, finite, global relativeL2/maxabs, row-relative-error quantiles, original output norm and activation quantization statistics; include bias consistently in both comparison outputs.
actual_activation_diagnostics.trajectory_boundary: These local comparisons see the candidate trajectory's X after earlier candidate layers. They do not prove equality to the original model trajectory or final output quality. Separate fresh native/candidate requests and original-policy20 evaluate downstream effects.
actual_activation_diagnostics.threshold: Register actual-activation criteria before running that stage. Do not relabel the random2% micro threshold as model accuracy or relax gates after seeing results. Record parsing, token repeatability and navigation outcomes under a distinct arithmetic protocol.
actual_activation_diagnostics.timing_exclusion: All CPU transfers, full-byte SHA, GPU reductions/.item synchronization and any diagnostic peak belong only to excluded warmups; no extra formal forward. Clear per-warmup diagnostic references afterward.

memory_estimate.reported_by_parent: Completed quiet AWQ inprocess2 whole-device sample peak6442MiB; GPTQ6432MiB; FP1611555MiB. Samples include desktop and occur at1s intervals, not true instantaneous per-process peaks. Child did not reread those GPU sample logs.
memory_estimate.interpretation: Rough feasibility scenario using6442+3469.219+256.512+114MiB. Components may overlap existing allocations and this omits conversion/allocator/graph/workspace peaks; it is not a measured peak or guaranteed bound. Actual allocated/reserved/device-free peaks decide applicability.
memory_estimate.decision: If actual startup/steady memory cannot fit on12GiB with original KV and other processes unchanged, report this route unsuitable; do not weaken controls to claim a gain.

required_receipts: New arithmetic identity/source/checkpoint/converter/layout hashes; actual144 expanded weight/scale hashes and per-module resident bytes.
Setup conversion/stream/weight mapping and allocation peaks; shared workspace capacities/strides/storage pointers; coldcompile guard and actual warm coverage.
Per-request candidate/native fallback projection counts with actual M/phase, decode native capture coverage and separately observed replay counts.
Excluded true-input local-error diagnostics and parsed outputs, then independent fixed/fullmodel latency and original-policy20 quality. Micro evidence alone never enables benefit fields.
